sky.qualification: Varda's sky orientation for its camera; the shared universe draws the visible sky.
sky.sceneRegistrationChain: galactic -> ICRF (J2000 constants) -> body-fixed (IAU pole and prime meridian at the epoch) -> ecliptic presentation frame

provenance.source: JPL Horizons fixed 2026-09-03 epoch. Assumes the spin pole aligns with Ilmarë’s orbit: J2000 RA 272.6° and declination −10.8°. This is a model prior; rotational phase and meridian are illustrative.
provenance.qualification: Computed Varda Sun direction at 2026-09-03T00:00:00 TT, expressed in the ecliptic presentation frame (north up, Sun left at zero yaw) and in view space at the default camera pose.
